title: Biologic for plaque psoriasis
notice: Fictional exercise criteria. Not a payer policy, prescribing guide, or clinical recommendation. Draft for pharmacist review. Modeled on common documentation patterns, without reproducing a real policy.
request_date_rule: Use the provider letter or form request date. Conflicting source dates require review. A numeric date that can be read two ways is settled only by a day above 12 elsewhere on the page or by a later fax-style received date. Otherwise it requires review.
logic: All five criteria require evidence. Missing evidence is not a denial. Contradiction, unclear duration, unconfirmed diagnosis, unreadable evidence and ambiguous dates require review.

criteria.text: Moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis is documented as the reason for this request. Psoriasis without that severity, a condition found only in a history or problem list, a suspected diagnosis, or a different requested indication does not meet this rule.
Body surface area involvement is at least 10%, measured within 180 days before the request.

Methotrexate at a stated dose for at least 90 days, with body surface area on or before the start and at least 90 days after the start that is still above 3%. A documented intolerance or contraindication to methotrexate, with its reason, also meets this rule.
The requested adalimumab maintenance dose is 40 mg every other week.
